enumeratedValue.description: If RXLVLENA in the FIFOTRIG register = 1, an interrupt will be generated when the when the RX FIFO level increases to the level specified by RXLVL in the FIFOTRIG register.

register.name: FIFOINTENCLR
register.description: FIFO interrupt enable clear (disable) and read register.

field.name: TXERR
field.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.

field.name: RXERR
field.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.

field.name: TXLVL
field.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.

field.name: RXLVL
field.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.

field.name: TXSSEL0_N
field.description: Transmit slave select. This field asserts SSEL0 in master mode. The output on the pin is active LOW by default.

field.name: TXSSEL1_N
field.description: Transmit slave select. This field asserts SSEL1 in master mode. The output on the pin is active LOW by default.

field.name: TXSSEL2_N
field.description: Transmit slave select. This field asserts SSEL2 in master mode. The output on the pin is active LOW by default.

field.name: TXSSEL3_N
field.description: Transmit slave select. This field asserts SSEL3 in master mode. The output on the pin is active LOW by default.

field.name: EOT
field.description: End of transfer. The asserted SSEL will be deasserted at the end of a transfer and remain so far at least the time specified by the Transfer_delay value in the DLY register.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_DEASSERTED
enumeratedValue.description: SSEL not deasserted. This piece of data is not treated as the end of a transfer. SSEL will not be deasserted at the end of this data.

enumeratedValue.name: DEASSERTED
enumeratedValue.description: SSEL deasserted. This piece of data is treated as the end of a transfer. SSEL will be deasserted at the end of this piece of data.

field.name: EOF
field.description: End of frame. Between frames, a delay may be inserted, as defined by the Frame_delay value in the DLY register. The end of a frame may not be particularly meaningful if the Frame_delay value = 0. This control can be used as part of the support for frame lengths greater than 16 bits.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_EOF
enumeratedValue.description: Data not EOF. This piece of data transmitted is not treated as the end of a frame.

enumeratedValue.name: EOF
enumeratedValue.description: Data EOF. This piece of data is treated as the end of a frame, causing the Frame_delay time to be inserted before subsequent data is transmitted.

field.name: RXIGNORE
field.description: Receive Ignore. This allows data to be transmitted using the SPI without the need to read unneeded data from the receiver. Setting this bit simplifies the transmit process and can be used with the DMA.

enumeratedValue.name: READ
enumeratedValue.description: Read received data. Received data must be read in order to allow transmission to progress. SPI transmit will halt when the receive data FIFO is full. In slave mode, an overrun error will occur if received data is not read before new data is received.

enumeratedValue.name: IGNORE
enumeratedValue.description: Ignore received data. Received data is ignored, allowing transmission without reading unneeded received data. No receiver flags are generated.

enumeratedValue.name: WRITETXDATA
enumeratedValue.description: Write transmit data. Transmit data must be written for each data exchange between master and slave. In slave mode, an underrun error occurs if transmit data is not provided before needed in a data frame.

enumeratedValue.name: IGNORETXDATA
enumeratedValue.description: Ignore transmit data. Data can be received without transmitting data (after FIFOWR has been initialized to set TXIGNORE). No transmitter flags are generated. When configured with TXIGNORE = 1, the slave sets the data to always 0.

field.name: LEN
field.description: Data Length. Specifies the data length from 4 to 16 bits. Note that transfer lengths greater than 16 bits are supported by implementing multiple sequential transmits. 0x0-2 = Reserved. 0x3 = Data transfer is 4 bits in length. 0x4 = Data transfer is 5 bits in length. 0xF = Data transfer is 16 bits in length.

field.name: RXSSEL0_N
field.description: Slave Select for receive. This field allows the state of the SSEL0 pin to be saved along with received data. The value will reflect the SSEL0 pin for both master and slave operation. A zero indicates that a slave select is active. The actual polarity of each slave select pin is configured by the related SPOL bit in CFG.

field.name: RXSSEL1_N
field.description: Slave Select for receive. This field allows the state of the SSEL1 pin to be saved along with received data. The value will reflect the SSEL1 pin for both master and slave operation. A zero indicates that a slave select is active. The actual polarity of each slave select pin is configured by the related SPOL bit in CFG.

field.name: RXSSEL2_N
field.description: Slave Select for receive. This field allows the state of the SSEL2 pin to be saved along with received data. The value will reflect the SSEL2 pin for both master and slave operation. A zero indicates that a slave select is active. The actual polarity of each slave select pin is configured by the related SPOL bit in CFG.

field.name: RXSSEL3_N
field.description: Slave Select for receive. This field allows the state of the SSEL3 pin to be saved along with received data. The value will reflect the SSEL3 pin for both master and slave operation. A zero indicates that a slave select is active. The actual polarity of each slave select pin is configured by the related SPOL bit in CFG.

field.name: SOT
field.description: Start of Transfer flag. This flag will be 1 if this is the first data after the SSELs went from deasserted to asserted (i.e., any previous transfer has ended). This information can be used to identify the first piece of data in cases where the transfer length is greater than 16 bits.

register.name: FIFORDNOPOP
register.description: FIFO data read with no FIFO pop.

field.name: FIFOSIZE
field.description: the fifo size is equal to the template parameter "fifo"/2 .

field.name: APERTURE
field.description: Aperture: encoded as (aperture size/4K) -1, so 0x00 means a 4K aperture.

field.name: ID
field.description: Module identifier for the selected function.

register.name: CFG
register.description: USART Configuration register. Basic USART configuration settings that typically are not changed during operation.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The USART is disabled and the internal state machine and counters are reset. While Enable = 0, all USART interrupts and DMA transfers are disabled. When Enable is set again, CFG and most other control bits remain unchanged. When re-enabled, the USART will immediately be ready to transmit because the transmitter has been reset and is therefore available.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The USART is enabled for operation.

field.name: DATALEN
field.description: Selects the data size for the USART.

enumeratedValue.name: BIT_9
enumeratedValue.description: 9 bit data length. The 9th bit is commonly used for addressing in multidrop mode. See the ADDRDET bit in the CTL register.

field.name: PARITYSEL
field.description: Selects what type of parity is used by the USART.

enumeratedValue.name: EVEN_PARITY
enumeratedValue.description: Even parity. Adds a bit to each character such that the number of 1s in a transmitted character is even, and the number of 1s in a received character is expected to be even.

enumeratedValue.name: ODD_PARITY
enumeratedValue.description: Odd parity. Adds a bit to each character such that the number of 1s in a transmitted character is odd, and the number of 1s in a received character is expected to be odd.

field.name: STOPLEN
field.description: Number of stop bits appended to transmitted data. Only a single stop bit is required for received data.

enumeratedValue.name: BITS_2
enumeratedValue.description: 2 stop bits. This setting should only be used for asynchronous communication.

field.name: MODE32K
field.description: Selects standard or 32 kHz clocking mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. USART uses the 32 kHz clock from the RTC oscillator as the clock source to the BRG, and uses a special bit clocking scheme.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. Break detect and generate is configured for normal operation.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. Break detect and generate is configured for LIN bus operation.

field.name: CTSEN
field.description: CTS Enable. Determines whether CTS is used for flow control. CTS can be from the input pin, or from the USART's own RTS if loopback mode is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: No flow control. The transmitter does not receive any automatic flow control signal.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Flow control enabled. The transmitter uses the CTS input (or RTS output in loopback mode) for flow control purposes.

field.name: CLKPOL
field.description: Selects the clock polarity and sampling edge of received data in synchronous mode.

enumeratedValue.name: FALLING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Falling edge. Un_RXD is sampled on the falling edge of SCLK.

enumeratedValue.name: RISING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Rising edge. Un_RXD is sampled on the rising edge of SCLK.

enumeratedValue.name: SLAVE
enumeratedValue.description: Slave. When synchronous mode is enabled, the USART is a slave.

enumeratedValue.name: MASTER
enumeratedValue.description: Master. When synchronous mode is enabled, the USART is a master.

enumeratedValue.name: LOOPBACK
enumeratedValue.description: Loopback mode. This provides a mechanism to perform diagnostic loopback testing for USART data. Serial data from the transmitter (Un_TXD) is connected internally to serial input of the receive (Un_RXD). Un_TXD and Un_RTS activity will also appear on external pins if these functions are configured to appear on device pins. The receiver RTS signal is also looped back to CTS and performs flow control if enabled by CTSEN.

field.name: OETA
field.description: Output Enable Turnaround time enable for RS-485 operation.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. If selected by OESEL, the Output Enable signal deasserted at the end of the last stop bit of a transmission.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. If selected by OESEL, the Output Enable signal remains asserted for one character time after the end of the last stop bit of a transmission. OE will also remain asserted if another transmit begins before it is deasserted.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. When addressing is enabled by ADDRDET, address matching is done by software. This provides the possibility of versatile addressing (e.g. respond to more than one address).

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. When addressing is enabled by ADDRDET, address matching is done by hardware, using the value in the ADDR register as the address to match.

enumeratedValue.name: STANDARD
enumeratedValue.description: Standard. The RTS signal is used as the standard flow control function.

enumeratedValue.name: RS_485
enumeratedValue.description: RS-485. The RTS signal configured to provide an output enable signal to control an RS-485 transceiver.

enumeratedValue.name: LOW
enumeratedValue.description: Low. If selected by OESEL, the output enable is active low.

enumeratedValue.name: HIGH
enumeratedValue.description: High. If selected by OESEL, the output enable is active high.

enumeratedValue.name: STANDARD
enumeratedValue.description: Standard. The RX signal is used as it arrives from the pin. This means that the RX rest value is 1, start bit is 0, data is not inverted, and the stop bit is 1.

enumeratedValue.name: INVERTED
enumeratedValue.description: Inverted. The RX signal is inverted before being used by the USART. This means that the RX rest value is 0, start bit is 1, data is inverted, and the stop bit is 0.

enumeratedValue.name: STANDARD
enumeratedValue.description: Standard. The TX signal is sent out without change. This means that the TX rest value is 1, start bit is 0, data is not inverted, and the stop bit is 1.

enumeratedValue.name: INVERTED
enumeratedValue.description: Inverted. The TX signal is inverted by the USART before being sent out. This means that the TX rest value is 0, start bit is 1, data is inverted, and the stop bit is 0.

register.name: CTL
register.description: USART Control register. USART control settings that are more likely to change during operation.

enumeratedValue.name: CONTINOUS
enumeratedValue.description: Continuous break. Continuous break is sent immediately when this bit is set, and remains until this bit is cleared. A break may be sent without danger of corrupting any currently transmitting character if the transmitter is first disabled (TXDIS in CTL is set) and then waiting for the transmitter to be disabled (TXDISINT in STAT = 1) before writing 1 to TXBRKEN.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. The USART presents all incoming data.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. The USART receiver ignores incoming data that does not have the most significant bit of the data (typically the 9th bit) = 1. When the data MSB bit = 1, the receiver treats the incoming data normally, generating a received data interrupt. Software can then check the data to see if this is an address that should be handled. If it is, the ADDRDET bit is cleared by software and further incoming data is handled normally.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Not disabled. USART transmitter is not disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. USART transmitter is disabled after any character currently being transmitted is complete. This feature can be used to facilitate software flow control.

field.name: CC
field.description: Continuous Clock generation. By default, SCLK is only output while data is being transmitted in synchronous mode.

enumeratedValue.name: CLOCK_ON_CHARACTER
enumeratedValue.description: Clock on character. In synchronous mode, SCLK cycles only when characters are being sent on Un_TXD or to complete a character that is being received.

enumeratedValue.name: CONTINOUS_CLOCK
enumeratedValue.description: Continuous clock. SCLK runs continuously in synchronous mode, allowing characters to be received on Un_RxD independently from transmission on Un_TXD).

enumeratedValue.name: NO_EFFECT
enumeratedValue.description: No effect. No effect on the CC bit.

enumeratedValue.name: AUTO_CLEAR
enumeratedValue.description: Auto-clear. The CC bit is automatically cleared when a complete character has been received. This bit is cleared at the same time.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. USART is in normal operating mode.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. USART is in autobaud mode. This bit should only be set when the USART receiver is idle. The first start bit of RX is measured and used the update the BRG register to match the received data rate. AUTOBAUD is cleared once this process is complete, or if there is an AERR.

register.name: STAT
register.description: USART Status register. The complete status value can be read here. Writing ones clears some bits in the register. Some bits can be cleared by writing a 1 to them.

field.name: RXIDLE
field.description: Receiver Idle. When 0, indicates that the receiver is currently in the process of receiving data. When 1, indicates that the receiver is not currently in the process of receiving data.

field.name: TXIDLE
field.description: Transmitter Idle. When 0, indicates that the transmitter is currently in the process of sending data.When 1, indicate that the transmitter is not currently in the process of sending data.

field.name: CTS
field.description: This bit reflects the current state of the CTS signal, regardless of the setting of the CTSEN bit in the CFG register. This will be the value of the CTS input pin unless loopback mode is enabled.

field.name: DELTACTS
field.description: This bit is set when a change in the state is detected for the CTS flag above. This bit is cleared by software.

field.name: TXDISSTAT
field.description: Transmitter Disabled Status flag. When 1, this bit indicates that the USART transmitter is fully idle after being disabled via the TXDIS bit in the CFG register (TXDIS = 1).

field.name: RXBRK
field.description: Received Break. This bit reflects the current state of the receiver break detection logic. It is set when the Un_RXD pin remains low for 16 bit times. Note that FRAMERRINT will also be set when this condition occurs because the stop bit(s) for the character would be missing. RXBRK is cleared when the Un_RXD pin goes high.

field.name: DELTARXBRK
field.description: This bit is set when a change in the state of receiver break detection occurs. Cleared by software.

field.name: START
field.description: This bit is set when a start is detected on the receiver input. Its purpose is primarily to allow wake-up from Deep-sleep or Power-down mode immediately when a start is detected. Cleared by software.

field.name: FRAMERRINT
field.description: Framing Error interrupt flag. This flag is set when a character is received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. This could be an indication of a baud rate or configuration mismatch with the transmitting source.

field.name: PARITYERRINT
field.description: Parity Error interrupt flag. This flag is set when a parity error is detected in a received character.

field.name: RXNOISEINT
field.description: Received Noise interrupt flag. Three samples of received data are taken in order to determine the value of each received data bit, except in synchronous mode. This acts as a noise filter if one sample disagrees. This flag is set when a received data bit contains one disagreeing sample. This could indicate line noise, a baud rate or character format mismatch, or loss of synchronization during data reception.

field.name: ABERR
field.description: Auto baud Error. An auto baud error can occur if the BRG counts to its limit before the end of the start bit that is being measured, essentially an auto baud time-out.

register.name: INTENSET
register.description: Interrupt Enable read and Set register for USART (not FIFO) status. Contains individual interrupt enable bits for each potential USART interrupt. A complete value may be read from this register. Writing a 1 to any implemented bit position causes that bit to be set.

field.name: TXIDLEEN
field.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when the transmitter becomes idle (TXIDLE = 1).

field.name: DELTACTSEN
field.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when there is a change in the state of the CTS input.

field.name: TXDISEN
field.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when the transmitter is fully disabled as indicated by the TXDISINT flag in STAT. See description of the TXDISINT bit for details.

field.name: DELTARXBRKEN
field.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a change of state has occurred in the detection of a received break condition (break condition asserted or deasserted).

field.name: STARTEN
field.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a received start bit has been detected.

field.name: FRAMERREN
field.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a framing error has been detected.

field.name: PARITYERREN
field.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when a parity error has been detected.

field.name: RXNOISEEN
field.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when noise is detected. See description of the RXNOISEINT bit in Table 354.

field.name: ABERREN
field.description: When 1, enables an interrupt when an auto baud error occurs.

register.name: INTENCLR
register.description: Interrupt Enable Clear register. Allows clearing any combination of bits in the INTENSET register. Writing a 1 to any implemented bit position causes the corresponding bit to be cleared.

field.name: TXIDLECLR
field.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.

field.name: DELTACTSCLR
field.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.

field.name: TXDISCLR
field.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.

field.name: DELTARXBRKCLR
field.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.

field.name: STARTCLR
field.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.

field.name: FRAMERRCLR
field.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.

field.name: PARITYERRCLR
field.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.

field.name: RXNOISECLR
field.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.

field.name: ABERRCLR
field.description: Writing 1 clears the corresponding bit in the INTENSET register.

register.name: BRG
register.description: Baud Rate Generator register. 16-bit integer baud rate divisor value.

field.name: BRGVAL
field.description: This value is used to divide the USART input clock to determine the baud rate, based on the input clock from the FRG. 0 = FCLK is used directly by the USART function. 1 = FCLK is divided by 2 before use by the USART function. 2 = FCLK is divided by 3 before use by the USART function. 0xFFFF = FCLK is divided by 65,536 before use by the USART function.

register.name: INTSTAT
register.description: Interrupt status register. Reflects interrupts that are currently enabled.

field.name: DELTACTS
field.description: This bit is set when a change in the state of the CTS input is detected.

field.name: DELTARXBRK
field.description: This bit is set when a change in the state of receiver break detection occurs.

field.name: START
field.description: This bit is set when a start is detected on the receiver input.

register.name: OSR
register.description: Oversample selection register for asynchronous communication.

field.name: OSRVAL
field.description: Oversample Selection Value. 0 to 3 = not supported 0x4 = 5 function clocks are used to transmit and receive each data bit. 0x5 = 6 function clocks are used to transmit and receive each data bit. 0xF= 16 function clocks are used to transmit and receive each data bit.

register.name: ADDR
register.description: Address register for automatic address matching.

field.name: ADDRESS
field.description: 8-bit address used with automatic address matching. Used when address detection is enabled (ADDRDET in CTL = 1) and automatic address matching is enabled (AUTOADDR in CFG = 1).

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The transmit FIFO is not enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: The receive FIFO is not enabled.

field.name: SIZE
field.description: FIFO size configuration. This is a read-only field. 0x0 = FIFO is configured as 16 entries of 8 bits. 0x1, 0x2, 0x3 = not applicable to USART.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: DMA is not used for the transmit function.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger DMA for the transmit function if the FIFO is not full. Generally, data interrupts would be disabled if DMA is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: DMA is not used for the receive function.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Trigger DMA for the receive function if the FIFO is not empty. Generally, data interrupts would be disabled if DMA is enabled.

field.name: WAKETX
field.description: Wake-up for transmit FIFO level. This allows the device to be woken from reduced power modes (up to power-down, as long as the peripheral function works in that power mode) without enabling the TXLVL interrupt. Only DMA wakes up, processes data, and goes back to sleep. The CPU will remain stopped until woken by another cause, such as DMA completion. See Hardware Wake-up control register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Only enabled interrupts will wake up the device form reduced power modes.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: A device wake-up for DMA will occur if the transmit FIFO level reaches the value specified by TXLVL in FIFOTRIG, even when the TXLVL interrupt is not enabled.

field.name: WAKERX
field.description: Wake-up for receive FIFO level. This allows the device to be woken from reduced power modes (up to power-down, as long as the peripheral function works in that power mode) without enabling the TXLVL interrupt. Only DMA wakes up, processes data, and goes back to sleep. The CPU will remain stopped until woken by another cause, such as DMA completion. See Hardware Wake-up control register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Only enabled interrupts will wake up the device form reduced power modes.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: A device wake-up for DMA will occur if the receive FIFO level reaches the value specified by RXLVL in FIFOTRIG, even when the RXLVL interrupt is not enabled.

field.name: EMPTYTX
field.description: Empty command for the transmit FIFO. When a 1 is written to this bit, the TX FIFO is emptied.

field.name: EMPTYRX
field.description: Empty command for the receive FIFO. When a 1 is written to this bit, the RX FIFO is emptied.

field.name: TXERR
field.description: TX FIFO error. Will be set if a transmit FIFO error occurs. This could be an overflow caused by pushing data into a full FIFO, or by an underflow if the FIFO is empty when data is needed. Cleared by writing a 1 to this bit.

field.name: RXERR
field.description: RX FIFO error. Will be set if a receive FIFO overflow occurs, caused by software or DMA not emptying the FIFO fast enough. Cleared by writing a 1 to this bit.

field.name: PERINT
field.description: Peripheral interrupt. When 1, this indicates that the peripheral function has asserted an interrupt. The details can be found by reading the peripheral's STAT register.

field.name: TXEMPTY
field.description: Transmit FIFO empty. When 1, the transmit FIFO is empty. The peripheral may still be processing the last piece of data.

field.name: TXNOTFULL
field.description: Transmit FIFO not full. When 1, the transmit FIFO is not full, so more data can be written. When 0, the transmit FIFO is full and another write would cause it to overflow.

field.name: RXNOTEMPTY
field.description: Receive FIFO not empty. When 1, the receive FIFO is not empty, so data can be read. When 0, the receive FIFO is empty.

field.name: RXFULL
field.description: Receive FIFO full. When 1, the receive FIFO is full. Data needs to be read out to prevent the peripheral from causing an overflow.

field.name: TXLVL
field.description: Transmit FIFO current level. A 0 means the TX FIFO is currently empty, and the TXEMPTY and TXNOTFULL flags will be 1. Other values tell how much data is actually in the TX FIFO at the point where the read occurs. If the TX FIFO is full, the TXEMPTY and TXNOTFULL flags will be 0.

field.name: RXLVL
field.description: Receive FIFO current level. A 0 means the RX FIFO is currently empty, and the RXFULL and RXNOTEMPTY flags will be 0. Other values tell how much data is actually in the RX FIFO at the point where the read occurs. If the RX FIFO is full, the RXFULL and RXNOTEMPTY flags will be 1.

register.name: FIFOTRIG
register.description: FIFO trigger settings for interrupt and DMA request.

field.name: TXLVLENA
field.description: Transmit FIFO level trigger enable. This trigger will become an interrupt if enabled in FIFOINTENSET, or a DMA trigger if DMATX in FIFOCFG is set.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO level does not generate a FIFO level trigger.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: An trigger will be generated if the transmit FIFO level reaches the value specified by the TXLVL field in this register.

field.name: RXLVLENA
field.description: Receive FIFO level trigger enable. This trigger will become an interrupt if enabled in FIFOINTENSET, or a DMA trigger if DMARX in FIFOCFG is set.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: Receive FIFO level does not generate a FIFO level trigger.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: An trigger will be generated if the receive FIFO level reaches the value specified by the RXLVL field in this register.

field.name: TXLVL
field.description: Transmit FIFO level trigger point. This field is used only when TXLVLENA = 1. If enabled to do so, the FIFO level can wake up the device just enough to perform DMA, then return to the reduced power mode. See Hardware Wake-up control register. 0 = trigger when the TX FIFO becomes empty. 1 = trigger when the TX FIFO level decreases to one entry. 15 = trigger when the TX FIFO level decreases to 15 entries (is no longer full).

field.name: RXLVL
field.description: Receive FIFO level trigger point. The RX FIFO level is checked when a new piece of data is received. This field is used only when RXLVLENA = 1. If enabled to do so, the FIFO level can wake up the device just enough to perform DMA, then return to the reduced power mode. See Hardware Wake-up control register. 0 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received one entry (is no longer empty). 1 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received two entries. 15 = trigger when the RX FIFO has received 16 entries (has become full).

register.name: FIFOINTENSET
register.description: FIFO interrupt enable set (enable) and read register.

field.name: TXERR
field.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a transmit error occurs, based on the TXERR flag in the FIFOSTAT register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: No interrupt will be generated for a transmit error.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: An interrupt will be generated when a transmit error occurs.

field.name: RXERR
field.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a receive error occurs, based on the RXERR flag in the FIFOSTAT register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: No interrupt will be generated for a receive error.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: An interrupt will be generated when a receive error occurs.

field.name: TXLVL
field.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a the transmit FIFO reaches the level specified by the TXLVL field in the FIFOTRIG register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: No interrupt will be generated based on the TX FIFO level.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: If TXLVLENA in the FIFOTRIG register = 1, an interrupt will be generated when the TX FIFO level decreases to the level specified by TXLVL in the FIFOTRIG register.

field.name: RXLVL
field.description: Determines whether an interrupt occurs when a the receive FIFO reaches the level specified by the TXLVL field in the FIFOTRIG register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: No interrupt will be generated based on the RX FIFO level.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: If RXLVLENA in the FIFOTRIG register = 1, an interrupt will be generated when the when the RX FIFO level increases to the level specified by RXLVL in the FIFOTRIG register.

register.name: FIFOINTENCLR
register.description: FIFO interrupt enable clear (disable) and read register.

field.name: TXERR
field.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.

field.name: RXERR
field.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.

field.name: TXLVL
field.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.

field.name: RXLVL
field.description: Writing one clears the corresponding bits in the FIFOINTENSET register.

field.name: RXDATA
field.description: Received data from the FIFO. The number of bits used depends on the DATALEN and PARITYSEL settings.

field.name: FRAMERR
field.description: Framing Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO, and indicates that the character was received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. This could be an indication of a baud rate or configuration mismatch with the transmitting source.

field.name: PARITYERR
field.description: Parity Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO. This bit will be set when a parity error is detected in a received character.

field.name: RXNOISE
field.description: Received Noise flag. See description of the RxNoiseInt bit in Table 354.

register.name: FIFORDNOPOP
register.description: FIFO data read with no FIFO pop.

field.name: RXDATA
field.description: Received data from the FIFO. The number of bits used depends on the DATALEN and PARITYSEL settings.

field.name: FRAMERR
field.description: Framing Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO, and indicates that the character was received with a missing stop bit at the expected location. This could be an indication of a baud rate or configuration mismatch with the transmitting source.

field.name: PARITYERR
field.description: Parity Error status flag. This bit reflects the status for the data it is read along with from the FIFO. This bit will be set when a parity error is detected in a received character.

field.name: RXNOISE
field.description: Received Noise flag. See description of the RxNoiseInt bit in Table 354.

field.name: FIFOSIZE
field.description: the fifo size is equal to the template parameter "fifo".

field.name: APERTURE
field.description: Aperture: encoded as (aperture size/4K) -1, so 0x00 means a 4K aperture.

field.name: ID
field.description: Module identifier for the selected function.

enumeratedValue.name: FEATURE_1
enumeratedValue.description: RAIP and RAIE register bits implemented on MUA side

enumeratedValue.name: FEATURE_2
enumeratedValue.description: MUA and MUB implemented with the same function. some bits in CR register are moved to CCR register.

enumeratedValue.name: FEATURE_4
enumeratedValue.description: some sync logic are deleted for synchronized MUA and MUB. RAIP and RDIP monitor Core reset instead of MU reset. Add HRIP and MURIP and their interrupt enable bits on both sides. Delete RS bit. Add COO mode in PM state.

register.name: PAR
register.description: Use Parameter register to determine the parameter settings of MUA.

enumeratedValue.name: Fn_0
enumeratedValue.description: Fn bit in the CR register is written 0 (default).

enumeratedValue.name: Fn_1
enumeratedValue.description: Fn bit in the CR register is written 1.

enumeratedValue.name: EP_0
enumeratedValue.description: The MUA side event is not pending (default).

enumeratedValue.name: EP_1
enumeratedValue.description: The MUA side event is pending.

enumeratedValue.name: RUN
enumeratedValue.description: The MUB processor is in Run Mode.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: The MUB processor is in WAIT Mode.

enumeratedValue.name: RS_0
enumeratedValue.description: The MUB side of the MU is not in reset.

enumeratedValue.name: RS_1
enumeratedValue.description: The MUB side of the MU is in reset.

enumeratedValue.name: FUP_0
enumeratedValue.description: No flags updated, initiated by the MUA, in progress (default)

enumeratedValue.name: RDIP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Processor B-side did not exit reset

enumeratedValue.name: RAIP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Processor B-side did not enter reset

enumeratedValue.name: TEn_0
enumeratedValue.description: MUA TRn register is not empty.

enumeratedValue.name: RFn_0
enumeratedValue.description: MUA RRn register is not full (default).

enumeratedValue.name: RFn_1
enumeratedValue.description: MUA RRn register has received data from MUB TRn register and is ready to be read by the MUA.

enumeratedValue.name: GIPn_0
enumeratedValue.description: MUA general purpose interrupt n is not pending. (default)

enumeratedValue.name: GIPn_1
enumeratedValue.description: MUA general purpose interrupt n is pending.

enumeratedValue.name: Fn_0
enumeratedValue.description: Clears the Fn bit in the SR register.

enumeratedValue.name: Fn_1
enumeratedValue.description: Sets the Fn bit in the SR register.

enumeratedValue.name: RDIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disables Processor A General Purpose Interrupt 3 request due to Processor B reset de-assertion.

enumeratedValue.name: RDIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables Processor A General Purpose Interrupt 3 request due to Processor B reset de-assertion.

enumeratedValue.name: RAIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disables Processor A General Purpose Interrupt 3 request due to Processor B reset assertion.

enumeratedValue.name: RAIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables Processor A General Purpose Interrupt 3 request due to Processor B reset assertion.

enumeratedValue.name: GIRn_0
enumeratedValue.description: MUA General Interrupt n is not requested to the MUB (default).

enumeratedValue.name: GIRn_1
enumeratedValue.description: MUA General Interrupt n is requested to the MUB.

field.name: GTFSM
field.description: ate Finite State Machine. The hardware gate is maintained in a 16-state implementation

enumeratedValue.name: GTFSM_1
enumeratedValue.description: The gate has been locked by processor 0.

enumeratedValue.name: GTFSM_2
enumeratedValue.description: The gate has been locked by processor 1.

enumeratedValue.name: RSTGSM_0
enumeratedValue.description: Idle, waiting for the first data pattern write.

enumeratedValue.name: RSTGSM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Waiting for the second data pattern write.

enumeratedValue.name: RSTGSM_2
enumeratedValue.description: The 2-write sequence has completed. Generate the specified gate reset(s). After the reset is performed, this machine returns to the idle (waiting for first data pattern write) state. The "01" state persists for only one clock cycle. Software cannot observe this state.

enumeratedValue.name: RSTGSM_3
enumeratedValue.description: This state encoding is never used and therefore reserved.

peripheral.name: OSTIMER0
peripheral.description: LPC_Next0 Synchronous OS/Event timer with Wakeup Timer

field.name: EVTIMER_COUNT_VALUE
field.description: A read reflects the current value of the lower 32 bits of the EVTIMER. Note there is physically only one EVTimer, readable from all domains.

field.name: EVTIMER_COUNT_VALUE
field.description: A read reflects the current value of the upper 32 bits of the EVTIMER. Note there is physically only one EVTimer, readable from all domains.

field.name: CAPTURE_VALUE
field.description: A read reflects the value of the lower 32 bits of the central EVTIMER at the time the last capture signal was generated by the CPU. A separate pair of CAPTURE registers are implemented for each CPU. Each CPU reads its own capture value at the same pair of addresses.

field.name: CAPTURE_VALUE
field.description: A read reflects the value of the upper 32 bits of the central EVTIMER at the time the last capture signal was generated by the CPU. A separate pair of CAPTURE registers are implemented for each CPU. Each CPU reads its own capture value at the same pair of addresses.

field.name: MATCH_VALUE
field.description: The value written to the MATCH (L/H) register pair is compared against the central EVTIMER. When a match occurs, an interrupt request is generated if enabled. A separate pair of MATCH registers are implemented for each CPU. Each CPU reads its own local value at the same pair of addresses.

field.name: MATCH_VALUE
field.description: The value written to the MATCH (L/H) register pair is compared against the central EVTIMER. When a match occurs, an interrupt request is generated if enabled. A separate pair of MATCH registers are implemented for each CPU. Each CPU reads its own local value at the same pair of addresses.

field.name: OSTIMER_INTRFLAG
field.description: This bit is set when a match occurs between the central 64-bit EVTIMER and the value programmed in the Match-register pair for the associated CPU This bit is cleared by writing a '1'. Writes to clear this bit are asynchronous. This should be done before a new match value is written into the MATCH_L/H registers

field.name: OSTIMER_INTENA
field.description: When this bit is '1' an interrupt/wakeup request to the Domainn processor will be asserted when the OSTIMER_INTR flag is set. When this bit is '0', interrupt/wakeup requests due to the OSTIMER_INTR flag are blocked.A separate OSEVENT_CTRL register is implemented for each CPU. Each CPU reads its own local value at the same address.

field.name: MATCH_WR_RDY
field.description: This bit will be low when it is safe to write to reload the Match Registers. In typical applications it should not be necessary to test this bit.

field.name: CRC_POLY
field.description: CRC polynomial: 1X = CRC-32 polynomial 01 = CRC-16 polynomial 00 = CRC-CCITT polynomial

field.name: BIT_RVS_WR
field.description: Data bit order: 1 = Bit order reverse for CRC_WR_DATA (per byte) 0 = No bit order reverse for CRC_WR_DATA (per byte)

field.name: CMPL_WR
field.description: Data complement: 1 = 1's complement for CRC_WR_DATA 0 = No 1's complement for CRC_WR_DATA

field.name: BIT_RVS_SUM
field.description: CRC sum bit order: 1 = Bit order reverse for CRC_SUM 0 = No bit order reverse for CRC_SUM

field.name: CMPL_SUM
field.description: CRC sum complement: 1 = 1's complement for CRC_SUM 0 = No 1's complement for CRC_SUM

field.name: CRC_SEED
field.description: A write access to this register will load CRC seed value to CRC_SUM register with selected bit order and 1's complement pre-processes. A write access to this register will overrule the CRC calculation in progresses.

field.name: CRC_SUM
field.description: The most recent CRC sum can be read through this register with selected bit order and 1's complement post-processes.

field.name: CRC_WR_DATA
field.description: Data written to this register will be taken to perform CRC calculation with selected bit order and 1's complement pre-process. Any write size 8, 16 or 32-bit are allowed and accept back-to-back transactions.

cluster.name: CHANNEL[%s]
cluster.description: Array of registers: DC_CTRL, DIVHFCLK, FIFO_CTRL, FIFO_DATA, FIFO_STATUS, GAINSHIFT, OSR, PHY_CTRL, PREAC2FSCOEF, PREAC4FSCOEF

field.name: OSR
field.description: Selects the oversample rate for the related input channel.

register.name: DIVHFCLK
register.description: Divider for generating PDM clock from DMIC clock input

field.name: PDMDIV
field.description: Divide by factor to create PDM Clock (enumerated type)

field.name: COMP
field.description: Co-efficient choice for CIC droop compensation droop filter

field.name: COMP
field.description: Co-efficient choice for CIC droop compensation droop filter

field.name: GAIN
field.description: Gain shift for decimator output (can be positive or negative number)

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO is not enabled. Enabling a DMIC channel with the FIFO disabled could be useful while data is being streamed to the I2S, or in order to avoid a filter settling delay when a channel is re-enabled after a period when the data was not needed.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO is enabled. The FIFO must be enabled in order for the CPU or DMA to read data from the DMIC via the FIFODATA register.

enumeratedValue.name: DISABLED
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO level interrupts are not enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLED
enumeratedValue.description: DMA requests based on FIFO level are enabled.

field.name: PHY_FALL
field.description: Capture DMIC on Falling edge (0 means on rising)

enumeratedValue.name: RISING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Capture PDM_DATA on the rising edge of PDM_CLK.

enumeratedValue.name: FALLING_EDGE
enumeratedValue.description: Capture PDM_DATA on the falling edge of PDM_CLK.

field.name: PHY_HALF
field.description: Use Half rate sampling (ie Clock to dmic is sent at half the speed than the decimator is providing)

enumeratedValue.name: STANDARD
enumeratedValue.description: Standard half rate sampling. The clock to the DMIC is sent at the same rate as the decimator is providing.

enumeratedValue.name: HALF_RATE
enumeratedValue.description: Use half rate sampling. The clock to the DMIC is sent at half the rate as the decimator is providing.

field.name: DCGAIN
field.description: Fine gain adjustment in the form of a number of bits to downshift.

enumeratedValue.name: DO_NOT_SATURATE
enumeratedValue.description: Results roll over if out range and do not saturate.

enumeratedValue.name: SATURATE
enumeratedValue.description: If the result overflows, it saturates at 0xFFFF for positive overflow and 0x8000 for negative overflow.

enumeratedValue.name: DO_NOT_SIGNEXTEND
enumeratedValue.description: The top byte of the FIFODATA register is always 0.

enumeratedValue.name: SIGNEXTEND
enumeratedValue.description: The top byte of the FIFODATA register is sign extended. This allows processing of 24-bit audio data on 32-bit machines.

field.name: EN_CH0
field.description: Enable channel 0. When 1, PDM channel 0 is enabled.

field.name: EN_CH1
field.description: Enable channel 1. When 1, PDM channel 1 is enabled.

field.name: EN_CH2
field.description: Enable channel 2. When 1, PDM channel 2 is enabled.

field.name: EN_CH3
field.description: Enable channel 3. When 1, PDM channel 3 is enabled.

field.name: EN_CH4
field.description: Enable channel 4. When 1, PDM channel 4 is enabled.

field.name: EN_CH5
field.description: Enable channel 5. When 1, PDM channel 5 is enabled.

field.name: EN_CH6
field.description: Enable channel 6. When 1, PDM channel 6 is enabled.

field.name: EN_CH7
field.description: Enable channel 7. When 1, PDM channel 7 is enabled.

field.name: CH_SYNC_EN
field.description: Choose which channels to sync to global sync (7:0) corresponds to the 8 channels

field.name: CCOUNTVAL
field.description: 32bit value, global sync counter will trigger a pulse whenever count reaches GCOUNTVAL

enumeratedValue.name: ASSERT_RESET
enumeratedValue.description: assert reset to decimator Note : resets are applied in pairs. So bit 0 corresponds to channels 0/1, bit1 corresponds to channels 2/3, bit2 to channel 4/5 and bit3 to channel 6/7

field.name: INPUTGAIN
field.description: Gain factor for input signal into HWVAD

field.name: HPFS
field.description: This field chooses the High Pass filter in first part of HWVAD

enumeratedValue.name: HIGH_PASS_1750HZ
enumeratedValue.description: High pass filter with -3dB cut-off at 1750Hz.

enumeratedValue.name: HIGH_PASS_215HZ
enumeratedValue.description: High pass filter with -3dB cut-off at 215Hz.

field.name: ST10
field.description: 1' means enter stage 1 of VAD, ie a sound change has been detected and the HWVAD is being allowed to settle. Use 0 when changing back to detection mode. Allow several milliseconds in stage 1 for settling.

enumeratedValue.name: NORMAL
enumeratedValue.description: Normal operation, waiting for HWVAD trigger event (stage 0).

enumeratedValue.name: RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Reset internal interrupt flag by writing a '1' pulse.

field.name: RSTT
field.description: Reset HWVAD. Write back to 0 to release reset.

field.name: THGN
field.description: Gain Factor for Noise-floor - use a positive number to make average less sensitive to sudden changes

field.name: THGS
field.description: Signal Gain factor - use a postive number to make current signal stand out more over longer term average

field.name: RELOAD_SHADOWS
field.description: Set to force re-loading the shadow registers (HW/SW capability and LOCK). This operation will automatically set OTP_STATUS.BUSY. Once the shadow registers have been re-loaded, OTP_STATUS.BUSY and RELOAD_SHADOWS are automatically cleared by the controller

field.name: CRC_TEST
field.description: Set to start CRC calculation. This operation will automatically set OTP_STATUS.BUSY. Once CRC is calculation done, OTP_STATUS.BUSY and CRC_TEST are automatically cleared by the controller

field.name: WORDLOCK
field.description: Set to write-lock the fuse word when it's being programming. When programming with ECC mode, it recommends to set this bit.

field.name: WR_UNLOCK
field.description: Write 0x3E77 to enable OTP write accesses. NOTE: The write operation must be unlocked for each word by writing 0x3E77 to WR_UNLOCK field. Then writing to OTP_WRITE_DATA register will automatically start the programming procedure.

field.name: PDN
field.description: This bit indicates the PDN value of OTP memory. Writing 1 to the bit to clear PDN. Writing 0 has no effect. Note: Software need to write 1 to this bit to shut off power of OTP memory after system power up. At the beginning of every fuse operation, the controller will automatically turn-on power to the OPT memory. After every fuse operation, software also need to write 1 to this bit to shut off power to the OTP memory to reduce power consumption.

field.name: WRITE_DATA
field.description: Fuse word programming data. After the write operation is unlocked in OTP_CTRL register, writing data to this register automatically start the programming procedure.

field.name: READ_DATA
field.description: Fuse word read data from read operation

field.name: DIV
field.description: Clock divider value by -1 encoding. It's used to generate the clock to OTP memory (otp_clk) with apb_clk. The maximum otp_clk frequency is 120Mhz. 0: Divide by 1

field.name: RESET
field.description: Resets the divider counter. Can be used to make sure a new divider value is used right away rather than completing the previous count.

field.name: HALT
field.description: Halts the divider counter. The intent is to allow the divider's clock source to be changed without the risk of a glitch at the output.

field.name: REQFLAG
field.description: Divider status flag. Set when a change is made to the divider value, cleared when the change is complete.

field.name: CRC_REF_ADDR
field.description: Specify which of the 8 CRC reference value to use for CRC calculation. When the CRC result for the fuse data from CRC_START_ADDR to CRC_AND_ADDR and this CRC reference value is 0, the CRC check passes.

field.name: CRC_VALUE
field.description: The CRC result value. When it is locked, reading from it returns value 32hBADA_BADA

field.name: SEC
field.description: OTP Single Error Corrected status of ECC during read operation. Write 1 to clear.

field.name: DED
field.description: OTP Double Error Detection status of ECC during read operation. Write 1 to clear.

field.name: LOCKED
field.description: OTP LOCKED status during read/write operation. Write 1 to clear.

field.name: PROGFAIL
field.description: OTP PROGFAIL status. Write 1 to clear.

field.name: PWOK
field.description: OTP Power OK status. Indicate that power VDD are in the operating range.

field.name: SEC_RELOAD
field.description: OTP Single Error Corrected status of ECC during reload process. Write 1 to clear.

field.name: DED_RELOAD
field.description: OTP Double Error Detect status of ECC during reload process. Write 1 to clear.

field.name: BUSY
field.description: OTP controller status bit. When active, no new write or read access to OTP (including RELOAD_SHADOWS) can be performed. Cleared by the controller when the access completes. After reset (or after setting RELOAD_SHADOWS), this bit is set by the controller and cleared after all the shadow registers are successfully loaded.

field.name: ERROR
field.description: Set by the controller when a read/write access to a locked region (OTP or shadow register) is requested. Writing 1 to clear it before any further access can be performed. This bit can only be set by the controller.

field.name: CRC_FAIL
field.description: CRC failed when set by hardware for CRC operation. Write 1 to clear.

field.name: FUSE_LATCHED
field.description: Indicate all shadows registers have been loaded with their corresponding fuse words when set by the controller after reset.

field.name: RXCLKSRC
field.description: Sample Clock source selection for Flash Reading

enumeratedValue.name: RXCLKSRC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback internally.

enumeratedValue.name: RXCLKSRC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Dummy Read strobe generated by FlexSPI Controller and loopback from DQS pad.

enumeratedValue.name: RXCLKSRC_3
enumeratedValue.description: Flash provided Read strobe and input from DQS pad

field.name: SERCLKDIV
field.description: The serial root clock could be divided inside FlexSPI wrapper. Refer Clocks chapter for more details on clocking.

field.name: HSEN
field.description: Half Speed Serial Flash access Enable.

enumeratedValue.name: HSEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: HSEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable divide by 2 of serial flash clock for half speed commands.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support disabled. AHB clock and serial clock will not be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Doze mode support enabled. AHB clock and serial clock will be gated off when there is doze mode request from system.

field.name: SCKFREERUNEN
field.description: This bit is used to force SCLK output free-running. For FPGA applications, external device may use SCLK as reference clock to its internal PLL. If SCLK free-running is enabled, data sampling with loopback clock from SCLK pad is not supported (MCR0[RXCLKSRC]=2).

field.name: LEARNEN
field.description: This bit is used to enable/disable data learning feature. When data learning is disabled, the sampling clock phase 0 is always used for RX data sampling even if LEARN instruction is correctly executed.

field.name: IPGRANTWAIT
field.description: Time out wait cycle for IP command grant.

field.name: AHBGRANTWAIT
field.description: Timeout wait cycle for AHB command grant.

field.name: AHBBUSWAIT
field.description: AHB Read/Write access to Serial Flash Memory space will timeout if not data received from Flash or data not transmitted after AHBBUSWAIT * 1024 ahb clock cycles, AHB Bus will get an error response

field.name: SEQWAIT
field.description: Command Sequence Execution will timeout and abort after SEQWAIT * 1024 Serial Root Clock cycles

field.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT
field.description: This bit determines whether AHB RX Buffer and AHB TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI returns STOP mode ACK. Software should set this bit if AHB RX Buffer or AHB TX Buffer will be powered off in STOP mode. Otherwise AHB read access after exiting STOP mode may hit AHB RX Buffer or AHB TX Buffer but their data entries are invalid.

enumeratedValue.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will not be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

enumeratedValue.name: CLRAHBBUFOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: AHB RX/TX Buffer will be cleaned automatically when FlexSPI return Stop mode ACK.

field.name: CLRLEARNPHASE
field.description: The sampling clock phase selection will be reset to phase 0 when this bit is written with 0x1. This bit will be auto-cleared immediately.

field.name: SAMEDEVICEEN
field.description: All external devices are same devices (both in types and size) for A1/A2/B1/B2.

enumeratedValue.name: SAMEDEVICEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: In Individual mode, FLSHA1CRx/FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2 separately. In Parallel mode, FLSHA1CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A1 and B1, FLSHA2CRx register setting will be applied to Flash A2 and B2. FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx register settings will be ignored.

enumeratedValue.name: SAMEDEVICEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: FLSHA1CR0/FLSHA1CR1/FLSHA1CR2 register settings will be applied to Flash A1/A2/B1/B2. FLSHA2CRx/FLSHB1CRx/FLSHB2CRx will be ignored.

field.name: SCKBDIFFOPT
field.description: B_SCLK pad can be used as A_SCLK differential clock output (inverted clock to A_SCLK). In this case, port B flash access is not available. After changing the value of this field, MCR0[SWRESET] should be set.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKBDIFFOPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: B_SCLK pad is used as port B SCLK clock output. Port B flash access is available.

enumeratedValue.name: SCKBDIFFOPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: B_SCLK pad is used as port A SCLK inverted clock output (Differential clock to A_SCLK). Port B flash access is not available.

field.name: RESUMEWAIT
field.description: Wait cycle (in AHB clock cycle) for idle state before suspended command sequence resumed.

field.name: APAREN
field.description: Parallel mode enabled for AHB triggered Command (both read and write) .

enumeratedValue.name: APAREN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: APAREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Parallel mode.

field.name: CACHABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus cachable read access support.

enumeratedValue.name: CACHABLEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will not check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer.

enumeratedValue.name: CACHABLEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. When there is AHB bus cachable read access, FlexSPI will check whether it hit AHB TX Buffer first.

field.name: BUFFERABLEEN
field.description: Enable AHB bus bufferable write access support. This field affects the last beat of AHB write access, refer for more details about AHB bufferable write.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFFERABLEEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. For all AHB write access (no matter bufferable or non-bufferable ), FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready after all data is transmitted to External device and AHB command finished.

enumeratedValue.name: BUFFERABLEEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. For AHB bufferable write access, FlexSPI will return AHB Bus ready when the AHB command is granted by arbitrator and will not wait for AHB command finished.

field.name: READADDROPT
field.description: AHB Read Address option bit. This option bit is intend to remove AHB burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: READADDROPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: There is AHB read burst start address alignment limitation when flash is accessed in parallel mode or flash is wordaddressable.

enumeratedValue.name: READADDROPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: There is no AHB read burst start address alignment limitation. FlexSPI will fetch more data than AHB burst required to meet the alignment requirement.

field.name: IPCMDDONEEN
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Execution finished interrupt enable.

field.name: IPCMDGEEN
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Grant Timeout interrupt enable.

field.name: AHBCMDGEEN
field.description: AHB triggered Command Sequences Grant Timeout interrupt enable.

field.name: IPCMDERREN
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Error Detected interrupt enable.

field.name: AHBCMDERREN
field.description: AHB triggered Command Sequences Error Detected interrupt enable.

field.name: IPRXWAEN
field.description: IP RX FIFO WaterMark available interrupt enable.

field.name: IPTXWEEN
field.description: IP TX FIFO WaterMark empty interrupt enable.

field.name: SCKSTOPBYRDEN
field.description: SCLK is stopped during command sequence because Async RX FIFO full interrupt enable.

field.name: SCKSTOPBYWREN
field.description: SCLK is stopped during command sequence because Async TX FIFO empty interrupt enable.

field.name: AHBBUSTIMEOUTEN
field.description: AHB Bus timeout interrupt.Refer Interrupts chapter for more details.

field.name: SEQTIMEOUTEN
field.description: Sequence execution timeout interrupt enable.Refer Interrupts chapter for more details.

field.name: IPCMDDONE
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Execution finished interrupt. This interrupt is also generated when there is IPCMDGE or IPCMDERR interrupt generated.

field.name: IPCMDGE
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Grant Timeout interrupt.

field.name: AHBCMDGE
field.description: AHB triggered Command Sequences Grant Timeout interrupt.

field.name: IPCMDERR
field.description: IP triggered Command Sequences Error Detected interrupt. When an error detected for IP command, this command will be ignored and not executed at all.

field.name: AHBCMDERR
field.description: AHB triggered Command Sequences Error Detected interrupt. When an error detected for AHB command, this command will be ignored and not executed at all.

field.name: IPRXWA
field.description: IP RX FIFO watermark available interrupt.

field.name: IPTXWE
field.description: IP TX FIFO watermark empty interrupt.

field.name: SCKSTOPBYRD
field.description: SCLK is stopped during command sequence because Async RX FIFO full interrupt.

field.name: SCKSTOPBYWR
field.description: SCLK is stopped during command sequence because Async TX FIFO empty interrupt.

field.name: AHBBUSTIMEOUT
field.description: AHB Bus timeout interrupt.Refer Interrupts chapter for more details.

field.name: KEY
field.description: The Key to lock or unlock LUT.

field.name: BUFSZ
field.description: AHB RX Buffer Size in 64 bits.

field.name: MSTRID
field.description: This AHB RX Buffer is assigned according to AHB Master with ID (MSTR_ID).

field.name: PRIORITY
field.description: This priority for AHB Master Read which this AHB RX Buffer is assigned. 7 is the highest priority, 0 the lowest.

field.name: PREFETCHEN
field.description: AHB Read Prefetch Enable for current AHB RX Buffer corresponding Master.

enumeratedValue.name: CSINTERVALUNIT_0
enumeratedValue.description: The CS interval unit is 1 serial clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: CSINTERVALUNIT_1
enumeratedValue.description: The CS interval unit is 256 serial clock cycle

field.name: CSINTERVAL
field.description: This field is used to set the minimum interval between flash device Chip selection deassertion and flash device Chip selection assertion. If external flash has a limitation on the interval between command sequences, this field should be set accordingly. If there is no limitation, set this field with value 0x0.

field.name: ARDSEQID
field.description: Sequence Index for AHB Read triggered Command in LUT.

field.name: ARDSEQNUM
field.description: Sequence Number for AHB Read triggered Command in LUT.

field.name: AWRSEQID
field.description: Sequence Index for AHB Write triggered Command.

field.name: AWRSEQNUM
field.description: Sequence Number for AHB Write triggered Command.

field.name: AWRWAIT
field.description: For certain devices (such as FPGA), it need some time to write data into internal memory after the command sequences finished on FlexSPI interface

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_0
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 2 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_1
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 8 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_2
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 32 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_3
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 128 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_4
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 512 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_5
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 2048 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_6
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 8192 ahb clock cycle

enumeratedValue.name: AWRWAITUNIT_7
enumeratedValue.description: The AWRWAIT unit is 32768 ahb clock cycle

field.name: CLRINSTRPTR
field.description: Clear the instruction pointer which is internally saved pointer by JMP_ON_CS. Refer Programmable Sequence Engine for details.

field.name: WMOPT1
field.description: Write mask option bit 1. This option bit could be used to remove AHB write burst start address alignment limitation.

enumeratedValue.name: WMOPT1_0
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is no limitation on AHB write burst start address alignment when flash is accessed in individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: WMOPT1_1
enumeratedValue.description: DQS pin will not be used as Write Mask when writing to external device. There is limitation on AHB write burst start address alignment when flash is accessed in individual mode.

field.name: WMENA
field.description: Write mask enable bit for flash device on port A. When write mask function is needed for memory device on port A, this bit must be set.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is disabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be un-driven when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is enabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be driven by FlexSPI as write mask output when writing to external device.

field.name: WMENB
field.description: Write mask enable bit for flash device on port B. When write mask function is needed for memory device on port B, this bit must be set.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENB_0
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is disabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be un-driven when writing to external device.

enumeratedValue.name: WMENB_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write mask is enabled, DQS(RWDS) pin will be driven by FlexSPI as write mask output when writing to external device.

field.name: SFAR
field.description: Serial Flash Address for IP command.

field.name: IDATSZ
field.description: Flash Read/Program Data Size (in Bytes) for IP command.

field.name: ISEQID
field.description: Sequence Index in LUT for IP command.

field.name: ISEQNUM
field.description: Sequence Number for IP command: ISEQNUM+1.

field.name: IPAREN
field.description: Parallel mode Enabled for IP command.

enumeratedValue.name: IPAREN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Individual mode.

enumeratedValue.name: IPAREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Flash will be accessed in Parallel mode.

field.name: TRG
field.description: Setting this bit will trigger an IP Command.

field.name: CLRIPRXF
field.description: Clear all valid data entries in IP RX FIFO.

field.name: RXDMAEN
field.description: IP RX FIFO reading by DMA enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: RXDMAEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO would be read by processor.

enumeratedValue.name: RXDMAEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: IP RX FIFO would be read by DMA.

field.name: CLRIPTXF
field.description: Clear all valid data entries in IP TX FIFO.

field.name: TXDMAEN
field.description: IP TX FIFO filling by DMA enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: TXDMAEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO would be filled by processor.

enumeratedValue.name: TXDMAEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: IP TX FIFO would be filled by DMA.

field.name: DLLRESET
field.description: Software could force a reset on DLL by setting this field to 0x1. This will cause the DLL to lose lock and re-calibrate to detect an ref_clock half period phase shift. The reset action is edge triggered, so software need to clear this bit after set this bit (no delay limitation).

field.name: SLVDLYTARGET
field.description: The delay target for slave delay line is: ((SLVDLYTARGET+1) * 1/32 * clock cycle of reference clock (serial root clock). If serial root clock is >= 100 MHz, DLLEN set to 0x1, OVRDEN set to =0x0, then SLVDLYTARGET setting of 0xF is recommended.

field.name: OVRDEN
field.description: Slave clock delay line delay cell number selection override enable.

field.name: OVRDVAL
field.description: Slave clock delay line delay cell number selection override value.

field.name: SEQIDLE
field.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in SEQ_CTL is idle and there is command sequence executing on FlexSPI interface.

field.name: ARBIDLE
field.description: This status bit indicates the state machine in ARB_CTL is busy and there is command sequence granted by arbitrator and not finished yet on FlexSPI interface. When ARB_CTL state (ARBIDLE=0x1) is idle, there will be no transaction on FlexSPI interface also (SEQIDLE=0x1). So this bit should be polled to wait for FlexSPI controller become idle instead of SEQIDLE.

field.name: ARBCMDSRC
field.description: This status field indicates the trigger source of current command sequence granted by arbitrator. This field value is meaningless when ARB_CTL is not busy (STS0[ARBIDLE]=0x1).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_0
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by AHB read command (triggered by AHB read).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by AHB write command (triggered by AHB Write).

enumeratedValue.name: ARBCMDSRC_2
enumeratedValue.description: Triggered by IP command (triggered by setting register bit IPCMD.TRG).

field.name: DATALEARNPHASEA
field.description: Indicate the sampling clock phase selection on Port A after Data Learning.

field.name: DATALEARNPHASEB
field.description: Indicate the sampling clock phase selection on Port B after Data Learning.

field.name: AHBCMDERRID
field.description: Indicates the sequence index when an AHB command error is detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[AHBCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

field.name: AHBCMDERRCODE
field.description: Indicates the Error Code when AHB command Error detected. This field will be cleared when INTR[AHBCMDERR] is write-1-clear(w1c).

enumeratedValue.name: AHBCMDERRCODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: AHB Write command with JMP_ON_CS instruction used in the sequence.

field.name: FEATURE
field.description: Feature Specification Number. This read only filed returns the feature set number.

field.name: MINOR
field.description: Minor Version Number. This read only field returns the minor version number for the module specification.

field.name: MAJOR
field.description: Major Version Number. This read only field returns the major version number for the module specification.

field.name: PARAM
field.description: Parameter Registers. This read only filed returns the feature parameters implemented along with the Version ID register.

field.name: HYSTCTR
field.description: Comparator hard block hysteresis control. See chip data sheet to get the actual hystersis value with each level

enumeratedValue.name: HYSTCTR_0
enumeratedValue.description: The hard block output has level 0 hysteresis internally.

enumeratedValue.name: HYSTCTR_1
enumeratedValue.description: The hard block output has level 1 hysteresis internally.

enumeratedValue.name: HYSTCTR_2
enumeratedValue.description: The hard block output has level 2 hysteresis internally.

enumeratedValue.name: HYSTCTR_3
enumeratedValue.description: The hard block output has level 3 hysteresis internally.

enumeratedValue.name: FILTER_CNT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Filter is disabled. If SE = 1, then COUT is a logic zero (this is not a legal state, and is not recommended). If SE = 0, COUT = COUTA.

enumeratedValue.name: FILTER_CNT_1
enumeratedValue.description: 1 consecutive sample must agree (comparator output is simply sampled).

enumeratedValue.name: OPE_0
enumeratedValue.description: When OPE is 0, the comparator output (after window/filter settings dependent on software configuration) is not available to a packaged pin.

enumeratedValue.name: OPE_1
enumeratedValue.description: When OPE is 1, and if the software has configured the comparator to own a packaged pin, the comparator is available in a packaged pin.

enumeratedValue.name: COS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Set CMPO to equal COUT (filtered comparator output).

enumeratedValue.name: COS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Set CMPO to equal COUTA (unfiltered comparator output).

enumeratedValue.name: INVT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Does not invert the comparator output.

enumeratedValue.name: PMODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Low Speed (LS) comparison mode is selected.

enumeratedValue.name: PMODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: High Speed (HS) comparison mode is selected.

enumeratedValue.name: CFF_0
enumeratedValue.description: A falling edge has not been detected on COUT.

enumeratedValue.name: CFF_1
enumeratedValue.description: A falling edge on COUT has occurred.

enumeratedValue.name: CFR_0
enumeratedValue.description: A rising edge has not been detected on COUT.

enumeratedValue.name: CFR_1
enumeratedValue.description: A rising edge on COUT has occurred.

enumeratedValue.description: CMP to DAC link is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: LINKEN_1

enumeratedValue.name: DMODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: DAC is selected to work in low speed and low power mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DMODE_1

enumeratedValue.description: The sampling takes place 1 round-robin clock cycle after the next cycle of the round-robin clock.

enumeratedValue.name: NSAM_3
enumeratedValue.description: The sampling takes place 3 round-robin clock cycles after the next cycle of the round-robin clock.

field.name: RR_TIMER_RELOAD
field.description: This field establishes the repetitive count rate for the timer. Each time the timer counts down to zero it is reloaded with this value. The rr_trig signal will be generated at a rate of (rr_timer_reload + 1) times the rr_clock period (typically 30.6 uS)

field.name: RR_TIMER_ENA
field.description: RR_TIMER enable. When low, rr_timer count will be held at zero. When set, timer will commence continuous, repetitive counting beginning with the 1st or 2nd rising edge of the 32 KHz rr_clock.1

enumeratedValue.name: RES_0
enumeratedValue.description: Up to 13-bit differential/12-bit single ended resolution supported.

enumeratedValue.name: RES_1
enumeratedValue.description: Up to 16-bit differential/15-bit single ended resolution supported.

enumeratedValue.name: DIFFEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Differential operation supported. CMDLa[DIFF] and CMDLa[ABSEL] control fields implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: MVI_1

enumeratedValue.name: CSW_6

enumeratedValue.name: TPRICTRL_0
enumeratedValue.description: If a higher priority trigger is detected during command processing, the current conversion is aborted and the new command specified by the trigger is started.

enumeratedValue.name: TPRICTRL_1
enumeratedValue.description: If a higher priority trigger is received during command processing, the current conversion is completed (including averaging iterations and compare function if enabled) and stored to the RESFIFO before the higher priority trigger/command is initiated.

enumeratedValue.name: PWREN_0
enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are only enabled while conversions are active. Performance is affected due to analog startup delays.

enumeratedValue.name: PWREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are pre-enabled and ready to execute conversions without startup delays (at the cost of higher DC current consumption). When PWREN is set, the power up delay is enforced such that any detected trigger does not begin ADC operation until the power up delay time has passed.

field.name: ENDEVPLUGINDET
field.description: Enables non-standard resistive plugged-in detection This bit field controls connection of nominal 200kohm resistors to both the USB_DP and USB_DM pins as one method of detecting when a USB cable is attached in device mode

enumeratedValue.name: ENDEVPLUGINDET_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disables 200kohm pullup resistors on USB_DP and USB_DM pins (Default)

enumeratedValue.name: ENDEVPLUGINDET_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables 200kohm pullup resistors on USB_DP and USB_DM pins

field.description: Writing a 1 to this bit will soft-reset the PWD, TX, RX, and CTRL registers

enumeratedValue.name: DEVPLUGIN_STATUS_1
